title: The Last Crown Revisited
author: Ada Okafor
blurb: Theo Dunmore, a debt-bound temple scribe, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
